title: Drawn Together
plot_overview: After being kidnapped and released, a wealthy businessman's daughter is assigned a bodyguard by her concerned father. Their difficult relationship gradually shifts as attraction grows, while they navigate a dangerous world filled with uncertainty and hidden agendas.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like romance built around danger, clashing personalities, and guarded characters; Not for you if you prefer grounded stories without melodrama or intrigue.
review_summary: Pros: romantic tension; dangerous atmosphere; opposites attract | Cons: familiar premise; limited context; no critical consensus
